raw_segments.text: A bloated carcass of a dog lay lolled on Blatterack.
Before him the gunnel of a boat sunk in sand.
Uncotch and sublay Louis Vuillot called Gaudier's pros.
These heavy sands are languaged tide and wind have silted here.
And these, the stone heaps of dead builders, a warren of weasel rats.
Mind you don't get one bang on the ear.
I'm the bloody well gigant rolls all them bloody well boulders.
I see Mel's to bloods, odds and iridsmen.
